name: PIBL-ES Lambda build failure — package size after PI AWS upgrade
description: Investigate and recommend fix for PIBL-ES Lambda Jenkins job failure: UpdateFunctionCode InvalidParameterValueException "Unzipped size must be smaller than 262144000 bytes" after partner-integrator AWS SDK 2.x upgrade. Document in partner-integrator/docs/2026-08-29-pibl-es-lambda-build-issue.md

entries.summary: Agent model: Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4.8) via GitHub Copilot CLI
entries.detail: Investigation and documentation performed by GitHub Copilot CLI powered by claude-opus-4.8.

entries.summary: Root cause: pi-bl-es-lambda shaded jar is 334.4 MB unzipped vs Lambda 250 MB (262144000 B) limit; AWS SDK upgrade tipped it over
entries.detail: Jenkins deploy fails: UpdateFunctionCode InvalidParameterValueException 'Unzipped size must be smaller than 262144000 bytes'. Measured shaded jar pi-bl-es-lambda-1.0.jar = 138 MB zipped / 350,672,249 B (334.4 MB) unzipped, over by 84.4 MB. Commit 8bba065f0e (ION-16417) replaced lean AWS SDK v1 dynamo-client (~4MB) with cloud-sdk-aws aggregate (AWS SDK 2.x for s3/ses/sns/sqs/ssm/dynamodb + 3 HTTP clients incl aws-crt native + transitive AWS SDK v1) ~40MB zipped. Stacked on org.elasticsearch:elasticsearch 8.17.0 server jar (35.5MB zipped, used only for QueryBuilders/SearchSourceBuilder to build query strings; actual ES I/O via Jest) and full Dropwizard/Jetty/POI/MyBatis/MySQL tree from commons (~25MB zipped, unused by a Lambda). Footprint by group (zipped): other 44.9, aws-sdk-v2 40.3, es+lucene 35.5, poi+xmlbeans 12.7, dropwizard/jetty 8.7, mysql+mybatis 4.0, aws-sdk-v1 3.8.

entries.summary: Validated fix: Maven exclusions on commons + cloud-sdk-aws drop jar to 177.7 MB unzipped (72MB under limit), 93/93 tests pass, no code change
entries.detail: Applied <exclusions> in pi-bl-es-lambda/pom.xml: from commons excluded dropwizard*/jetty*/jersey*/hk2*/mysql/mybatis/poi/xmlbeans/curvesapi/jsoup/spring-security-crypto; from cloud-sdk-aws excluded AWS v2 s3, s3-transfer-manager, sesv2, sns, sqs, ssm, url-connection-client, aws-crt-client(+native aws-crt), amazon-sqs-java-extended-client-lib, AWS v1 aws-java-sdk-core/sqs/sns/s3, handlebars, javax.mail. CRITICAL: must NOT exclude software.amazon.awssdk:apache-client — cloud-sdk DynamoDbClientConfig uses ApacheHttpClient; excluding it -> NoClassDefFoundError in HandlerSupportTest. Keep exactly one sync HTTP client (Apache). Result: shaded jar 76.9MB zipped / 186,299,610 B (177.7MB) unzipped, UNDER 262144000 by 72.3MB. mvn -pl partner-integrator/pi-bl-es-lambda package: BUILD SUCCESS, 93 tests, 0 failures/errors. Lambda Layers do NOT help (250MB limit = code + layers combined). Future: remove ES server jar by rewriting query building (Jest/co.elastic client) for ~80MB more. Changes staged in working tree, not committed — awaiting user confirmation.

entries.summary: Expanded fix: 3-path exclusions + Indexer.java cleanup drop full web stack; jar now 146.5 MB unzipped, 93/93 tests pass
entries.detail: Extended web-stack exclusions (io.dropwizard*, jetty*, jersey*, hk2*) to cloud-sdk-api and cloud-sdk-aws in addition to commons. Source cleanup in Indexer.java: removed dead @Timed annotation (no metrics registry/AOP in raw lambda) and replaced org.eclipse.jetty.io.RuntimeIOException with java.io.UncheckedIOException (3 throw sites); IndexerTest.java updated (import + 3 assertThrows). Result: dropwizard/jetty/jersey/hk2/codahale absent from tree; shaded jar 153,598,295 B (146.5 MB) unzipped, 103.5 MB under limit; mvn package BUILD SUCCESS, 93/93 tests pass. apache-client retained (cloud-sdk needs ApacheHttpClient).

entries.summary: Review comment assessment: wildcard exclusions DO work (reviewer's mechanism wrong); real gap was dropwizard on 3 dependency paths + actual code usage
entries.detail: Reviewer claimed wildcard artifactId exclusions don't work. Verified FALSE: Maven supports wildcard * in exclusion groupId/artifactId since 3.2.1 (MNG-5600); build uses Maven 3.9.11. Proof: wildcard exclusions org.apache.poi:*, org.apache.xmlbeans:*, mysql:*, org.mybatis:*, org.springframework.security:* all took effect (jar 334->178MB). BUT reviewer surfaced a real gap: dropwizard-core (->jetty/jersey/hk2) is declared by ALL THREE in-house aggregates (commons, cloud-sdk-api, cloud-sdk-aws); excluding from one just re-resolves via the next (transitive whack-a-mole). Concrete artifact IDs would NOT have fixed it. Also Indexer.java actually used com.codahale.metrics.annotation.@Timed and org.eclipse.jetty.io.RuntimeIOException, so blanket-excluding the stack broke compilation.

entries.summary: Confirmed @Timed was inert (no interceptor/registry); added real logged index() duration instead. Commit 886e867480, 93/93 tests pass
entries.detail: Verified @Timed was inert in the Lambda: Indexer built via new Indexer(jestClient) in IndexerHandler line 48; no MetricRegistry/SharedMetricRegistries, no Guice Injector/AbstractModule/bindInterceptor, no JAX-RS/Jersey InstrumentedResourceMethodApplicationListener anywhere in module -> nothing intercepts @Timed, so no timer recorded. It was likely live when code ran inside a Dropwizard/Jersey service historically. Replaced lost intent with real dependency-free timing: System.nanoTime() around index(), elapsed ms appended to existing info log ('Indexed bl %s in %d ms'). Commit 886e867480. mvn package BUILD SUCCESS, 93/93 tests; jar size unchanged 146.5 MB unzipped.

entries.summary: Added and verified Git Bash/Unix equivalents (find/awk/stat/jar/unzip) for the size-measurement commands in §11
entries.detail: Added a 'Git Bash / Unix equivalents for steps 1.5-1.7' subsection to §11 of 2026-08-29-pibl-es-lambda-build-issue.md. Verified all commands run in the repo's Git Bash: 1.5 find -printf+awk; 1.6A `jar tvf | awk '{sum+=$1} END{...}'` (JDK, portable) and 1.6B `unzip -l | tail -1 | awk` both yield identical unzipped bytes (matched .NET zip-entry method); 1.7 dependency:build-classpath -> tr ';'/'\\' -> stat -c %s per jar -> awk group by .m2 path segment after /repository/ -> sort. Documented that a .jar is a ZIP so tar cannot read it (use jar tvf or unzip). Doc is gitignored (**/docs/), not committed.
